name: Diego Téllez Barrero
headline: AI-native Senior Software Engineer · Distributed Systems · Applied AI
summary: Senior software engineer working across distributed systems, applied AI, cloud infrastructure and backend platforms. Shipped production NLP, GenAI and RAG services; built systems supporting hundreds of thousands of players; reduced AWS costs by approximately $50,000 per year. My focus is AI-native engineering: understanding the problem, designing maintainable systems, using AI to build, verifying the result and taking responsibility for product outcomes.
engineeringFocus: AI-native software engineering: problem framing, system design, technical judgment, AI-assisted implementation, verification and ownership of customer and business outcomes.

currentFocus.releaseNote: 2027 is the creator's current plan. The Steam listing has not announced a release date.

highlights: Lead end-to-end development of Echoes of the Cove, a commercial cross-platform 2D action RPG planned for 2027.
Own a custom C# / MonoGame-based engine, scripting systems, AI behavior, physics, data-driven gameplay and developer tooling.
Profile and optimize CPU, memory and rendering performance; manage production planning, QA, build pipelines and release preparation.
Provide technical direction and integration standards for external contributors. Full-time focus since leaving the last employed role in October 2025.
Built high-performance FastAPI endpoints exposing AI models and automated ML/DL training, validation and serving pipelines.
Worked with PostgreSQL, vector stores, Pydantic and LangChain / LangGraph to deliver production AI features.
Deployed and monitored solutions on AWS with Docker, Kubernetes and GitHub Actions.
Designed and maintained distributed server systems for mobile games supporting hundreds of thousands of players.
Focused on scalable architecture, runtime performance, reliability and fault tolerance using C#, TypeScript and cloud infrastructure.
The company ceased operations in June 2025.
Built an AI-driven education platform using custom agents and the Gemini API to create personalized learning experiences.
Used conversational assessment to generate structured courses, curate articles and videos and create quizzes.
Featured in the Google Gemini API Developer Competition project showcase.
Developed and deployed production NLP, GenAI and RAG applications, microservices and APIs in the Machine Learning Products & APIs team.
Built backend services, frontend interfaces and databases while improving scalability, security, code quality and maintainability.
Built developer tools, internal platforms and reusable libraries for reliable service-to-service communication.
Worked across platform reliability, experimentation, security, backend services and developer experience.
Led a database cleanup initiative that reduced AWS costs by approximately $50,000 per year.
Designed and implemented Jenkins CI/CD pipelines and automated rich Grafana dashboards during application deployment.
Built and maintained an internal developer platform, a development CLI, core services and a monorepo of more than 60 Node.js applications.
Designed and developed a platform connecting professionals in Spain with remote work opportunities.
Owned product planning, a React single-page application, Node.js / Express APIs and deployment on Netlify and Render.
Taught the MERN stack through coding challenges, small projects, progress reviews and hands-on debugging.
Reviewed student code and taught clear code, separation of responsibilities, SOLID, DRY and effective use of documentation.
Contributed to a cross-platform greenhouse management application showing sensor data and controlling lighting, humidity and temperature schedules.
Built with TypeScript, Angular 12 and Ionic 5, including a reusable Angular data-access library; worked with Docker, Kubernetes, ArgoCD and Google Cloud deployment tooling.
